messages:
trevor: Quick sync — handoff for private-installer v1.6.3 -> Hydra transport tonight 23:00 UTC. Need signer + checksum verification before transport. @mia?

mia: On it. ETA 22:50 to run cosign and KMS checks. Is the build immutable (shrinkwrap) or we still have delta patches?

trevor: Shrinkwrap, build-id: bld-20240521-116. No further deltas expected. We need cosign + sha256 + artifact manifest pinned.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] artifact-move job queued: hydra-move-bld-20240521-116. Start window 23:00 UTC. Notify: #eng-releases.

ash: Holding a hard stop: if transport fails >15% chunk errors or signer mismatch, abort and failover to mirror-b. Confirming rollback criteria. @kumar can you validate mirror-b capacity?

kumar: mirror-b has capacity for 2 concurrent streams. fallback plan ok. Also prepping quick revert script:
```
# revert mirror pointer
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN" https://ops.redwood.internal/mirror/revert -d '{"manifest":"bld-20240521-116"}'
```

jules: Cosign TTL note: if cosign key rotation occurs during window, deploy-bot will reject. We've put a 10m grace on the signer rotation for tonight.

mia: Running cosign verify now. sha256: 1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d... (truncated). Confirm manifest matches.

mia: Signed with KMS key redwood-install-v2. Cosign sig: cosign:abcd...

trevor: thanks. @deploy-bot proceed on my mark. Canary will ship to one onprem seed (seed-07) first, hold 10m, then fanout.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] moving artifact -> hydra transport started 23:01 UTC. job id hydra-20240521-23-01.

ash: Observability knobs: if 95th latency for transfer > 6s or chunk error rate > 5% abort. I'll watch metrics.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] chunk errors: 0.4% — ok. throughput nominal.

kumar: mirror-b healthy, can take over if needed.

trevor: Canary success at 23:12 on seed-07. No regressions. Proceeding to scale to remaining seeds.

jules: Noted: post-delivery task — publish release-note snippet + pinned manifest to internal catalog.

mia: Signed off for release. Good job team :tada:

trevor: Closing thread — archiving notes in release-ticket #RL-5123 and tagging package as v1.6.3-transported.
